Navigation

Navigazione aerea tattica

A military navigation system (TACAN) providing bearing and distance information to aircraft, functionally similar to VOR/DME but used mainly for military operations.

Questions and answers

What is Navigazione aerea tattica?

In this glossary, Navigazione aerea tattica refers to: A military navigation system (TACAN) providing bearing and distance information to aircraft, functionally similar to VOR/DME but used mainly for military operations.

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Procedi direttamente verso la stazione TACAN Alfa, attendi i vettori per l’avvicinamento finale."

Definition

A military navigation system (TACAN) providing bearing and distance information to aircraft, functionally similar to VOR/DME but used mainly for military operations.

Operational example

Proceed direct to TACAN station Alpha, expect vectors for final approach.

Localized term

Navigazione aerea tattica

Localized example

Procedi direttamente verso la stazione TACAN Alfa, attendi i vettori per l’avvicinamento finale.
